# Maison Tarot
> Demystify mysticism. A bilingual (FR/EN) house, online from Paris, where you learn to read tarot — sessions, workshops, free events — built on a documented method: 300 blind readings, hit rate published (≈ 90% by the author's own count, not audited), misses included. No "gift", no Chosen Ones, no guaranteed outcome. Entertainment framing. Adults only.

## Key pages
- /method/ and /fr/methode/ : the method, the numbers, and what the author does not claim
- /sessions/ and /fr/sessions/ : one-to-one sessions (you pay for the lesson; a reading may happen inside it)
- /workshops/ and /fr/ateliers/ : group workshops by lens (colours, numbers, elements, energies, astrology)
- /events/ and /fr/evenements/ : free online reading events and in-person meetups
- /library/ and /fr/bibliotheque/ : free knowledge base — elements, energies, numerology, astrology, colorimetry, symbols, the 78 Rider-Waite-Smith cards, Kabbalah, history, historical figures
- /guide/ and /fr/guide/ : the free Readers' Guide
- /blog/ and /fr/blog/ : articles

## Positioning
Cards aren't magic, you are. Anyone can learn to read; the systems (numbers, elements, astrology) are lenses so you never memorise 78 meanings. The author refuses readings on health, death, pregnancy, ongoing legal matters, investments, and "curses". No hierarchy, no dependency, no cult.

## Markets
French: France, Belgium, Switzerland (Romandie), Luxembourg, Monaco, Québec. English: United States (no Pennsylvania), Canada, United Kingdom, Australia.
